notes.title: While We Wait Here will be released on October 23rd
notes.notes:
While We Wait Here will launch on October 23rd, 2024. The game will be available on Xbox, PlayStation 4 & 5, Nintendo Switch, and for PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store. The game will be priced at $4.99 and will receive a launch day discount!

Enjoy the launch trailer.

[previewyoutube=5Pi15kqruas;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Thank you for all your feedbacks!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

thanks to everyone who decided to download our demo! We are very happy with all the feedbacks gathered during this Steam Next, Your reactions to "While We Wait Here" are amazing and we spent the last two weeks watching all your gameplay and reading your precious feedbacks on the game. 

We read every single comment and we hope to give you news on the release as soon as possible!

The demo will stay up in case you didn't have the chance to try it out so you can play it while we all wait here for the full release ;)

notes.title: Dave the Diver's evil cousin is a scary cooking sim with a Steam demo
notes.notes:
The world is ending. Armageddon looms. A huge, spiraling tornado threatens to engulf everything, with meteorites falling from the sky. This is While We Wait Here. Sure, it sounds like a far cry from Dave the Diver's playful, sushi-eating adventure, but Bad Vices Games' new release has a lot in common with its cozier counterpart.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Demo Available Now
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
we can finally share with you what we've been working on for the last months and we are really excited to know what you think about it.

It’s just an ordinary day at Nora and Cliff’s diner; you’re in the middle of nowhere, flipping burgers, serving drinks, and enjoying good old fashioned conversation…
Then suddenly, a regular summer’s day is turned upside down with the arrival of a frighteningly giant storm. Some play it off, others believe it may actually be the beginning of the end. 
Nothing, in either case, is really what it seems.

[b]The demo is 15 to 20 minutes long with two endings.[/b] It's really important for us to listen to your feedbacks. You can leave them by going into "Your feedback" in the main menu of the game or you can post in in the Steam discussions or in our Discord server, the choice is up to you. 

We will read everyone comments ;) 

[b]Here's also a new trailer[/b]
Have fun!
